name: steam-mcp
description: FastMCP 3.2 Steam portmanteau server — profile, library, stats, store, workshop, and publishing tools with React dashboard and Prefab UI cards
author: Sandra Schipal

tools.name: steam_profile
tools.description: Query Steam player profiles: own profile, player summaries, friend list, and vanity URL resolution. Requires STEAM_API_KEY.

tools.name: steam_library
tools.description: Access your Steam game library: owned games with playtime, recently played titles, app store details, and wishlist. Requires STEAM_API_KEY.

tools.name: steam_stats
tools.description: Game stats: per-player achievements, global achievement rarity percentages, concurrent player counts (no key needed), and leaderboards.

tools.name: steam_store
tools.description: Steam store search, latest news for any app, and user reviews with scores. No API key required.

tools.name: steam_workshop
tools.description: Browse Workshop mods and community content by game with popularity sorting. Requires STEAM_API_KEY.

tools.name: steam_system
tools.description: Server health, tool registration status, and SteamCMD binary detection for publishing workflows.

tools.name: steam_publish
tools.description: Steamworks publishing pipeline: readiness checklist, monetization guide, VDF generation, and SteamPipe upload orchestration with dry-run support.

tools.name: steam_help
tools.description: Multi-level help for all Steam-MCP tools, operations, and auth requirements.

tools.name: agentic_steam_workflow
tools.description: Multi-step Steam queries via host LLM sampling (SEP-1577): describe a goal in natural language and the agent chains tools to answer.

tools.name: show_steam_status_card
tools.description: Prefab UI card showing Steam-MCP connectivity and auth status at a glance.

tools.name: show_library_card
tools.description: Prefab UI card summarizing owned games with playtime data.

tools.name: show_store_search_card
tools.description: Prefab UI card displaying Steam store search results.

tools.name: show_workshop_card
tools.description: Prefab UI card browsing Workshop items for a game.

tools.name: show_player_count_card
tools.description: Prefab UI card showing current in-game player count.
